sanitizedEvidence.summary: Synapse issued 07/8F with argument 00 at 7.847479 seconds immediately before enabling temporary full charge.
The enable action issued 07/0F with argument 04 at 7.865825 seconds.
A separate checked-to-unchecked capture issued 07/8F 00 followed by 07/0F 00 at 9.715326 and 9.736894 seconds.
The 20-second idle baseline stopped gracefully and contained no operator setting change.
Exact-device 07/8F 00 reads returned inactive before setup, active after enable, and inactive after cancellation.
With baseline Limit80 and temporary full charge false, OpenBlade enabled, read back true, cancelled, read back false, and confirmed Limit80 restoration.
Three exact production-factory probes exposed limit 70 plus temporary full charge, opened successfully, and returned temporary full charge false.

productionAdmission.identityScope: RZ09-0528, BIOS 2.02, USB 1532:02C6, HID usage 0001:0002, 91-byte feature reports

limitations: Battery protection off and uncaptured charge-limit setters remain unavailable.
Active Synapse feature traffic can race the shared feature response; OpenBlade rejects unrelated acknowledgements.
Keyboard lighting remains off at the operator's request.
Raw PCAPs and unique device identifiers remain private and uncommitted.
notes: Final charge limit was 80 percent, temporary full charge was unchecked, and actual battery state remained on AC at 79 percent.
